acceptance_criteria: Exact 60/20 worlds, 142184/45942 sequences, 39310/13693 identity-valid observations, 102874/32249 open-set observations, 3380/1113 disjoint identities and all ten topology families are preserved.
Pair cache reproduces 57066/18111 open-set and 135232/45372 total fit/selection pairs under the explicitly corrected strictly-past 3D <=16m definition.

All three seeds use their exact sealed GSE checkpoints with zero backbone optimizer step; model inputs exclude pose, identity, parent, traversal and future information; pair scores are exactly query/candidate symmetric.

Each seed independently has a nonempty selected threshold with aggregate precision>=0.98, false accept<=0.01 and recall>=0.25; each of ten topology families has nonempty acceptance, precision>=0.95 and recall>=0.10.
C09/C10/M-TARE reads remain zero; source seals remain identical before/after; host RSS<=8GiB, GPU allocation<=4GiB, duration<=6h and output<=2GiB.
baseline: The immutable descriptor-only calibration and Gate-4 V2 failure: best online precision 0.514286, while an open-set descriptor threshold could reach zero false accepts only by collapsing correct accepts to 46/3/2 and recall below 1%.

estimated_cost.compute: One RTX 5090 D, three serial frozen GSE inference passes and three small verifier trainings; <=8GiB host RSS, <=4GiB GPU allocation, zero simulator/ROS.

expected_evidence: Approved Data Card/spec, corrected pair manifest and cache hashes, source seals and frozen environment.
Three frozen observation feature arrays, fit-only normalization, epoch logs, best checkpoints and complete C07-C08 score archives.
Aggregate and all-ten-family precision/recall/accepted counts per seed, resource metrics, raw logs, RUN_STATE and complete SHA-256 seal.
method: For each frozen GSE seed, export deployment-only typed features over C01-C08; fit a matchability MLP and an exactly symmetric pair MLP on C01-C06 existing identity pairs plus one same-parent strictly-past 3D <=16m open-set negative per eligible invalid query; select checkpoint and one non-vacuous threshold on C07-C08 only.

optimization.checkpoint_selection: minimum complete C07-C08 class-balanced association BCE independently per seed
optimization.threshold_selection: maximum recall subject to aggregate precision>=0.98, false accept<=0.01, recall>=0.25 and per-family nonempty precision>=0.95/recall>=0.10

pair_contract.candidate_definition: same parent, association-valid candidate, strictly lower world_sequence_row, 3D Euclidean sensor-position distance <=16m, nearest distance then lower global sequence index

question: Can a lightweight verifier on frozen GSE typed outputs reject ordinary corridor observations and preserve useful same-place structural association at precision >=0.98 and recall >=0.25 across every topology family?
stop_conditions: Any old impossible 157644/52621 total-pair claim is used, or candidate ordering/distance/partition/count drifts.
Any source, checkpoint, tool, environment, split, feature, symmetry, resource or evidence drift; any C09/C10/M-TARE read or backbone update.
Any seed lacks a non-vacuous passing threshold. Seal FAIL and stop before C09 topology; do not lower gates or tune graph/planner parameters.

user_authorization.confirmation_reference: The user selected option A and granted continuing in-scope execution without repeated approvals; active goal continuation followed the explicit report of corrected reproducible counts.
user_authorization.scope: One immutable Gate-3 open-set corrective using 60 C01-C06 fit worlds, 20 C07-C08 selection worlds, three frozen GSE checkpoints and corrected 135232/45372 pair populations; zero C09/C10/M-TARE reads.
